checks.requirement: C++23/latest Kit and complete data/service/QML/test target closure on macOS and Linux
checks.evidence: Top-level required C++23 and capability probe precede Qt discovery with unversioned find_package. Both desktop Unix branches compile the same MusicTypes/LibraryModels and IMetadataProvider/OfflineMetadataProvider/LibrarySession into YalahooCore; only Qt Core and existing Gui are linked, with no Network or platform API. Application links that core and generates moc/foreign QML registration from actual headers. Both real test targets inherit C++23 and use Qt Test/Qml/Quick/Gui; plugin path comes from the selected Kit. Existing platform function contains MSVC flags only under WIN32, Unix warning flags in its actual branches. Native shell forwards preset arguments and runs configure/build/CTest; default is now Release. Windows Release proves shared compilation and all registered tests.
checks.limitations: No macOS/Linux compiler or linker was executed; local Qt platform collation differences remain possible. Latest native Kit is selected again on the target host.

checks.requirement: Unicode/local URLs, metadata provenance, stable role and ID resolution, transactional JSON
checks.evidence: readLibrary stages a value then moves it only after validating collections and stable/unique album/track IDs. Source URLs accept local files and native absolute paths, preserve Unicode/#/spaces through QUrl; no cwd expansion or disk scanning occurs. Cached provenance URLs stay JSON/text, without an opener. Each object retains unknown fields and writes known fields over the original JSON; no source tags or caches are written. Snapshot references are const and owned while models resolve IDs. QML receives a C++ owned session via initial properties, module resource loading remains independent of cwd; foreign types and roleNames match the public headers. Missing row returns invalid QVariant, snapshot/sort resets use begin/endResetModel and notifications. Synthetic round-trip/duplicate/bad-array/local-URL tests and actual Unicode cwd window pass.
checks.limitations: No target filesystem was accessed. Legacy browser/HTTP paths remain opaque for explicit R22 import. QCollator backend differences are documented and visual fixture column ordering is fixed.

checks.requirement: Data/QML probe integration preserves existing native rendering and shader resource closure
checks.evidence: New QML type registration and a count Label do not change the View3D camera/material/geometry, uniform layout, framebuffer depth, texture direction, MSAA or shader source. Platform preprocessing still chooses Metal only for macOS and OpenGL only for Linux, D3D11 only for Windows. QML overlays follow normal Qt Quick composition; no separate render thread reads the session. Existing shader-tools test dumps actual qsb variants and existing asset/runtime suites pass on Windows Release, including real three-shell model pixels and the bound anonymous count. Rendering-specific R04 changes beyond this overlay are N/A; production rendering remains assigned to R06 onward.
checks.limitations: Existing qsb variants are static target evidence only; no Metal/GL execution on macOS/Linux, and no production visual parity is claimed in this data round.

checks.requirement: Navigation/playback independence, offline-only replaceable provider, asynchronous token/generation/cancellation/lifecycle
checks.evidence: Constructed product provider is OfflineMetadataProvider with networkEnabled=false. Its requests capture a const local cache snapshot, post a context-bound zero-timer callback, and only read cached fields. Missing/unqueried content returns Deferred with no retry date; existing content/state/provenance is returned without requery even for force. Pending tokens use all three identity fields, cancel marks only that exact token, provider destruction cancels context callbacks. Session posts all result delivery through a queued connection and rejects expired/mismatched requestId/generation/albumId/kind and duplicate completions. Request replacement clears earlier pending operations before provider cancellation; library replacement increments generation, and provider/session destruction is guarded by QPointer/connections. Search/sort/navigate/requestMetadata do not set playback IDs or touch media; explicit setPlaybackIds is C++ only and playing IDs survive index replacement. Test provider exercises Matched/Uncertain/Error on the identical QML component, with no service-name branch. Actual audio output/source/EndOfMedia functionality is not introduced here and remains R24/R25; existing media construction uses Qt public API. Source audit finds no request, process-launch or forbidden PCM APIs in core/services.
checks.limitations: No real music is read or played. One Windows TCP/child snapshot is corroborating evidence rather than a whole-lifetime packet trace; absence of network dependencies/APIs completes the offline proof. Qt context timer semantics: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtimer.html.

checks.requirement: Traceable frozen-source oracle, real Release Windows evidence, no unresolved static defects
checks.evidence: Golden exporter reads the immutable Git blob, strips only TypeScript declarations and executes its function body against anonymous fixtures. C++ compares exact stable album/track pairs in all 216 cases, and compares all fixture libraries and columns against the R01 order artifact; sorting/model/JSON/provider tests cover additional boundaries. verify-r04 runs Release only, requires all ten registered CTest suites, clean data/QML diagnostics, qmllint and passed real GPU/QML/mouse reports, and saves redacted paths/XML/oracle hashes. Automated audit checks source and oracle hashes and output evidence; each COMMON result also carries this explicit manual branch/call/error-path trace. The old Debug outputs are not used for R04 acceptance. No statically determinable platform defect remains in the R04 data/service boundary.
checks.limitations: Target compile, collation, QML and GUI results await user validation; this matrix does not replace R31/R32 complete platform audit or claim platform runtime/performance.
